• The scheme was later replaced by the **Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) **in **2008**, which continues to provide financial assistance to **start-ups and micro-enterprises.**

• The scheme provided **subsidy up to 15% **of the** project cos**t, subject to a **maximum of Rs. 7,500 per entrepreneur **for setting up of new projects.
 
• The **Seventh Five Year Plan** focused on **accelerating economic growth **and modernizing the industry, while the** Ninth Five Year Plan **emphasized on** poverty reduction **and** human development.**

questions.question: Which of the following is used to chemically test starch?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** lodine solution.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iodine solution** is used to **chemically test** for the **presence of starch.**
 
• When iodine solution is added to a sample that contains starch, the solution turns **blue-black** in color.
 
• Chlorine solution is** not **used to test for starch.
 
 
• Chlorine is a **strong oxidizing agent** and can react with **starch**, but this reaction is not specific to starch and can occur with other organic compounds as well.
 
 
 
• Sulphur solution is also** not **used to test for starch.
 
 
• Sulphur is **not known to react** with starch in a way that produces a** visible color change.**
 
 
 
• Bromine solution is **sometimes used to test** for starch, but it is** less **commonly used than iodine solution.
 
 
• When bromine solution is added to a sample that contains starch, the solution turns **orange in color.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Starch** is a** complex carbohydrate** that is commonly found in** plants.**
 
• It is an** important source of energy** for **humans and animals.**
 
• Starch is made up of two types of molecules: **amylose and amylopectin**.
 
• Amylose is a** linear molecule,** while amylopectin is **highly branched.**
 
• Both types of molecules can be detected with **iodine solution.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2** (iodine solution) as it specifically reacts with starch to produce a** blue-black color.**
